shops.premiumCallout: Free: 1 shop · 6 items · no lootboxes. Upgrade to Premium for up to 10 shops, 50 items, lootboxes, and member shops.

userShops.title: Member shops
userShops.subtitle: Enable personal member shops and moderate their items.
userShops.enabledHelp: Members can create a shop on the website; others can buy via /shop with a user selected.
userShops.lootboxNote: Members can only create inventory or IRL items. Roles and lootboxes remain admin-shop only.
userShops.listHelp: Moderate member shops: review items and delete when needed.
userShops.deleteShopConfirmText: Delete shop "{shop}" owned by {owner} and its {count} item(s)? This cannot be undone.
userShops.deleteItemConfirmText: Delete "{item}" from shop "{shop}" ({owner})? This cannot be undone.

inventories.title: Member inventories
inventories.subtitle: Browse inventories, search a member and remove items when needed.
inventories.hint: Only members with at least one item are listed.
inventories.selectUserHelp: Pick a member from the list to view their items.
inventories.emptyItems: This member has no items in their inventory.
inventories.removeConfirm: Remove {count} item(s) from the user's inventory?
inventories.removeError: Could not remove this item from the inventory.

automation.title: Automatic gains
automation.stackableHelp: Stackable means multiple boosters add up (e.g. x1.2 + x1.3). If disabled, only the highest multiplier applies.

shopItems.title: Shop items
shopItems.premiumItemsHint: Free: up to 6 items per shop, no lootboxes. Premium: up to 50 items, lootboxes, and up to 10 server shops.
shopItems.trashHelp: Items remain usable in inventory as long as quantity > 0.
shopItems.typeHelp: role/temp_role grants a role. inventory/irl adds an item to inventory.
shopItems.lootboxPremiumHint: Lootboxes are reserved for the Premium plan.
shopItems.tempRoleDurationHelp: The role will be removed automatically after this time.
shopItems.availabilityHelp: If set, the item is only visible/purchasable during this window.
shopItems.availabilityRangeHelp: Dates must be between today and 5 years from now; “From” must be on or before “To”.

sections.pricingHelp: Price, stock, discounts and activation dates.

shopItems.dmAfterBuy: Send a DM to the owner after purchase
shopItems.dmAfterOpen: Send a DM to the owner after purchase and opening
shopItems.lootboxHelp: Add up to 20 entries. Configure each row with a custom item.
shopItems.lootboxTip: Tip: for roles, select them as in a regular item creation.
shopItems.confirmPurge:
Also delete this item from inventories?
OK = delete from inventories, Cancel = remove only from lootbox.

errors.roleRequired: Add at least one role for this item.
errors.lootboxEmpty: Add at least one lootbox entry.
errors.lootboxMissingTempDuration: Lootbox: missing temporary role duration on line {line}.
errors.availabilityFromPast: The “From” date cannot be before today.
errors.availabilityToPast: The “To” date cannot be before today.
errors.availabilityTooFar: The date cannot be more than 5 years from today.
errors.availabilityRangeInvalid: The “From” date must be on or before the “To” date.

deleteItem.hideHelp: the item disappears from the shop but remains in inventories
deleteItem.deleteHelp: the item is removed from the shop and inventories
deleteItem.purgeLootbox: Also remove lootbox items from inventories
